lokele: Oyasota lokasa-lo ale ko’mi Paulo, bɔkɔwa wa Yesu Masiya la oyatomoko lioi ndoyala Botomomu, yüchomokö ndonangola Mboli Ilau ya Mungu,
english: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, 1:1 called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,

lokele: eyatikak’Inde lisakä ko kwalakwala ko la Batɔndɔli bance nda Lokasa loa Mungu.
english: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,

lokele: Mboli Ilau-bi yende loasɔ loa Wana wande oyaotomokö wana wa bofindi wa Dawidi nda lokomba loa bolomboki,
english: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring 1:3 of David according to the flesh,

lokele: Inde asɛlɔmɔkɔ Wana wa Mungu ko la bofoka nda bolimo wa botanu ko loasɔ loa litɛmwi nda liwa, Inde ako Yesu Masiya Ngɛnɛ wasu;
english: who was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,

lokele: ko l’eoka yande tosɔɔlɔ elame la isosha sha Botomomu shɔɔlɛsɛ bato ba wenda bototina lilendelu eoka ya lina liande,
english: through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations for his name’s sake;

lokele: la ino imɔ osotomo lioi amamwito lau mbo oyaleke eba Yesu Masiya.
english: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;

lokele: Ende batotina ebasamomu la Mungu nda Loma bako ebasotomo lioi ndüchakomoko ende Mungu, isotomel’ino bootaota la lilatemi, bako eba Mungu Sango wasu la ba Ngɛnɛ wasu Yesu Masiya.
english: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lokele: Oso, isotafaefa Mungu wami kelekëlë ko la Yesu Masiya eoka yanu batotina eoka mbo lilendelu lianu lioimela Yesu lisotomo lokuku nda wenda bototina.
english: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.

lokele: Mungu Inde angɛnɛ nd’aluwi to, eoka isokuwel’Inde la bolimo wami ani itonangokola Mboli Ilau ya Wana wande, mbo iitomacha ndosingwaka baina banu nda basomboli bami,
english: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,

lokele: ani itolɔmbɔkɔlɔ mbo yendesomoko ndoyɛnɛ ino ko la lisangi lia Mungu.
english: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.

lokele: Eoka yende la yɛmɛ yɔɛn’ino mbo ifek’ino lifaefi limɔi lia Bolimo mbo bokɔkɔmɛkɛ kɔkɛ,
english: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;

lokele: litina mbo iso lanu lami tosungakaneke nda lilendelu liasu.
english: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.

lokele: Ilɛmbi nd’ino beoto, ndoluwa mbo yasangaka mbile wike ndoya end’ino mbo yɔlɛkɛ eula omolo eyanu kwa aɔlɔkɔ̈’mi nda yese yasi, kongo ko isokufesomo kɔni ndoya konda eweuse.
english: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you (and was hindered so far), that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.

lokele: Yende la bolima bokambela BaHela la Basenje, ende eba wɛli l’eba bibebe lisanga,
english: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.

lokele: eokao yende la yɛmɛ kwa atokɔkɔlɔ’mi ndonangola Mboli Ilau imɔ ko end’ino ebale nda bokenge wa Loma. Batotina nda wenda bende la boeno wa liengani ko la lilendelu
english: So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.

lokele: Iti to la sɔni loasɔ loa Mboli Ilau; eoka yende ko bofoka wa Mungu bouwekesa batotina ebatolendelo Yesu Masiya, BaYuda oso limɔ BaHela.
english: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.

lokele: Eoka ko la Mboli Ilau liengani lia Mungu lisoisolomo ko la lilendelu likɛkɛ konda lilendelu lifi; kwa atomokö loao nda Lokasa loa Mungu mbo— Eba liengani beikaka ko la lilendelu.
english: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.” Habakkuk 2:4

lokele: Efango ya Mungu losokwa nda use, yao loisolomo ende batotina ebatotefola Mungu la ebatiengane ebatokufesa wewe ko la njasɔ ibe yao.
english: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,

lokele: Eoka, yao ebile yoluwomo loasɔ loa Mungu bisoɛnɛlɛ end’iyo eoka Mungu nd’asoɛnɛs’iyo yao.
english: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.

lokele: Eyande ebitiɛnɛlɛ to konda lokelomu loa wenda, biko bofoka wande wa layalaya la boyaeli wande wa Mungu, bitoluwana ko la yao ebisokelomo lande; eokao bati la lioi ango limɔi lia liasala,
english: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity, that they may be without excuse.

lokele: eoka kwa aluwaka’iyo Mungu, batialitesak’Inde la batiainakelak’Inde, kongo ko basolefaka nda baenyeli la betema ya ebisoomelo liluwani bisotufatufa nda lilima.
english: Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.

lokele: Aongak’iyo mbo bende ba wɛli, iyo lokinjwa ko bibebe
english: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

lokele: la iyo lofangola bofɛkɔ wa Mungu wa lokato ko la bilimi ya bato la nɔli la nyama ya bakolo banɛi la yao ebitokaowaowa nda nyɛlɛ.
english: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, four-footed animals, and creeping things.

lokele: Eokao, Mungu lomach’iyo nda bɔwɛwɛ wa yɛmɛ ibe ya betema yau ndotombokolana bindo yau angɛnɛ,
english: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves;

lokele: eoka basofangola wewe wa Mungu ko la lolanga limɔ basosemokola la basolitesa yao ebikelomu nda lifa lia Bokeli angɛnɛ— Inde ainelomoko la loomalo layalaya, ongoma.
english: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.

lokele: Eokao, Mungu lomachel’iyo nda yɛmɛ ibe ya sɔni finɛ; batomali lofetekwana boyaeli wa batomali la wao eboti wa botomali angɛnɛ,
english: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.

lokele: la batolome ko ongoma lomachaka ndɔɔtɛlɛ batomali bau, iyo lofɛfɛ la bolëfë wokelana la batolome basi njasɔ ya sɔni, ongoma iyo loaelo nda bindo yau angɛnɛ bosombo wa litwanelo liau.
english: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.

lokele: Limɔ kwa iyo batikulie ndoluwa Mungu, ko ongoma Mungu asomachel’iyo boenyaenya wa bobe ebotikuliomo la ndokelaka boendu.
english: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;

lokele: Bato ana basotuma la njasɔ; bitotina ebitiengane, la bobe la bolole la luno, basotuma imɔ la lisiëlä la lioli lia bato, la bosho, la bolimbake, la bolalo,
english: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,

lokele: basɛɔli ba basi, biyani la Mungu, eba tofälä, bɔmɛtɔ, bɔfɛnɔa, bafɔɔli ba obe, batefoli ba sango la nyango,
english: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

lokele: bibebe, batomboli ba basakä, ebati la booto, eba angwɛnɛ liwa-ngandi.
english: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;

lokele: Bɔfɔnɔ-bo wa bato nd’aluwi likomyi lia Mungu, liko mbo, ebatokelaka njasɔ ya bɔfɔnɔ-bo bengani nde ndowa, kongo ko iyo angɛnɛ batokelaka yao, nde batoimela imɔ ko la olau basi ebatokelaka imɔ ko yao.
english: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.

lokele: Eokao, aɛ oyatofaka boto wasi se, oti ango la lioi lia liasala lioonga eoka atof’aɛ wasi se, aɛ angɛnɛ imɔ osofomo se; eoka otokelaka aɛ angɛnɛ ko ongoma.
english: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.

lokele: Toluwi nde mbo likomyi lia Mungu lile ngo ko wewe elitofaka bato se ebatokelaka bɔfɔnɔ-bo wa obe.
english: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.

lokele: ¿Aɛ boto oyatofa bato ebatokelaka yao se, ani aɛ angɛnɛ otokelaka yao, otangi nde mbo otolonga ndotila likomyi lia Mungu?
english: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?

lokele: ¿Mbo osoolya booto la limɛsɛli lifi lia Mungu la liombakeli liande eliti la esole? ¿Otiluwe mbo booto bofi wa Mungu botokɔkɔlɔ ndoinwes’aɛ ko nda likalangani?
english: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?

lokele: Kongo ko eoka ya bowau wa botema waɛ ebotikalangane, aɛ angɛnɛ osoukamesa bondanda wa efango eyekawɛlɛmɛkɛ end’aɛ nda lise lia efango elitoɛnɛlɛ nda likomyi lia Mungu,
english: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God,

lokele: oyatɔɔlɛsɛ boto la boto bondanda woengana la bekeeli yande;
english: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:” Psalms 62:12

lokele: ende ebasokɔkɔmɔ nda bekeeli bilau yolukaka tala la loliteso la loiko, atof’iyo ko liwawi lia layalaya;
english: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;

lokele: nde ende tochocho etoitolitesa momongo, kangä ko yao ebitiengane, bɛwɛlɔmɔkɔ efango la lisomi.
english: but to those who are self-seeking and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,

lokele: Bifembi la bomusi bilawɛlɔmɔkɔ nda botema wa boto oyatokelaka bobe, ende BaYuda oso la BaHela lisanga.
english: oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

lokele: Nde tala la loliteso la lilatemi ende boto la boto oyatokelaka bolau, ende BaYuda oso la BaHela lisanga.
english: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

lokele: Eoka Mungu aitokwelakwela bɔmbɔ wa boto nda likomyi liande.
english: For there is no partiality with God.

lokele: Eoka batotina ebasokelaka obe, ani batiluwe Bikela ya Mɔsɛ, belakuchomoko, nde inga to la bieo ya Bikela; kongo ko batotina ebasokelaka obe ani baluwi Bikela, ambo belafomoko se ko la Bikela.
english: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.

lokele: Bati to ebatolaila Bikela kongo ebatoengana nda baiso ba Mungu, kangä ebatolitesa yao nd’atofomo likolo nda likomyi.
english: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified

lokele: Eoka atolitesa bato ba wenda olitesa Bikela ko la betema yau angɛnɛ, ani bati to la Bikela, ambo betema yau yende bikela end’iyo;
english: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,

lokele: ambo batotamba bato basi mbo bikela bisotakomo kwa yao ya Lokasa nda betema yau, olo eluwanelo ya olau la obe etokuliana ndoluwesa la wɛli, angoko baenyeli bau bataf’iyo se angoko ndof’iyo lioi lia liasala,
english: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)

lokele: nda lise lina elitokomya Mungu okomyela njasɔ ebiisami nda betema ya bato ko la Yesu Masiya-kwa atoekesomo ko la Mboli Ilau ebisonangola’mi.
english: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.

lokele: Nde eya to mbo watomo lina liko WaYuda la bolendelo ngo ko Bikela ya Mɔsɛ la boomalaka la bɔmɛtɔ nda lina lia Mungu,
english: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,

lokele: mbo oluwi nde lisangi liande la otangi nde mbo Bikela bisoeta la olau ebisoekesomo aɛ,
english: know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,

lokele: la boluwa ndoluwaka mbo aɛ wende botoli oso w’eba botuku woɛnɛs’iyo mboka, la mbo wende imɔ imwɛli shofachela ebale nda lilima,
english: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,

lokele: la mbo wende imɔ boluwekesi w’ebati la liluwani la boekesi wa bainɛngɛ eoka wende la boyaeli wa liluwani la wewe nda Bikela yanu,
english: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.

lokele: aɛ boekesi wa boto wasi, oitoekesa botema waɛ angɛnɛ? ¿Oyatotaka boeki mbo— Wiyëke! Aɛ angɛnɛ wiyaka nde?
english: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?

lokele: ¿Oyatoonga mbo angotwa nyongo, aɛ angɛnɛ ototwaka nyongo? ¿Oyatooka bakëngë la fengö bɔlɛlɔ, aɛ angɛnɛ otoiya yeka ya ndakɔ ya mungu ya bɔfɔnɔ?
english: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

lokele: Oyatoomala l’ifäälä eoka ya Bikela, ototefwesa Mungu ani ototefola Bikela?
english: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?

lokele: Kwa asɔnɔmɔkɔ nda Lokasa, ko ongoma-Lina lia Mungu litotomo bɔkɛcha nda tukela bitotina ko l’eoka yanu.
english: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” Isaiah 52:5 just as it is written.

lokele: Liteni lia itombe lile la litina lilau ani osolitesa Bikela ya Mɔsɛ, nde botefokola Bikela, limɔ liteni liaɛ lia itombe lile ngo ko losunga wawa.
english: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

lokele: ¿Eokao to, eya mbo boto wa losunga elitekesa baiti ba Bikela, losunga elole lande angotangomo to mbo liteni lia itombe?
english: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?

lokele: Ongoma oyatikali ngo losunga, nde kolitesa Bikela, inde nd’atokomyel’aɛ oyale la Lokasa loa Mungu la liteni lia itombe lisanga, nde ototefokola Bikela.
english: Won’t those who are physically uncircumcised, but fulfill the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?

lokele: Eoka boto ati to WaYuda oyakweli nde bɔfɔnɔ wande ko lousa, la liteni elisoɛnɛlɛ nda lokomba liti elia wewe;
english: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;

lokele: kongo ko boto ale WaYuda oyayali ongoma ko nda botema wande, la liteni lia itombe lile loasɔ loa botema imɔ, ndembe ya bolimo, inga ndembe eyetomu nda lokasa. WaYuda wa wewe atiinelomo la bato, kangä ko la Mungu.
english: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.

lokele: ¿Eya to ongoma BaYuda bafoti nde l’iye? ¿Boni bondanda bofomu nde la liteni lia itombe?
english: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?

lokele: Wike, ko la batina wike; elia oso ko mbo ende BaYuda Baoi ba Mungu basotikomo mbo batinganeke la bao.
english: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.

lokele: Ko la moni to? ¿Bamɔi beyalaka la boeno wa lilendelu; fee yau kosɛɛsɛlɛsɛ likɔchi lia Mungu liokɔcha basakä bande?
english: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?

lokele: Mbayo, ango sinyo! Kangä mbo batotina baluweke mbo Mungu ende ko momongo, ani basi batotina bende ko la nanga; kwa atomoko nda Lokasa mbo— Mbo wenganesomoko wewe ko la baoi baɛ, La bolongesomoko ani otokomyielomo loasɔ.
english: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.” Psalms 51:4

lokele: Nde ango batwanelo basu bɛnɛkɛsɛ liengani lia Mungu, ¿iso koonga moni? ¿Mbo Mungu atiengane ani atokuchak’iso la efango yande? Imi bolomboki nd’atoonga kongo.
english: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.

lokele: Mbayo, ango sinyo! Eya ongoma, ani Mungu kokomya njasɔ ya wenda-bo la moni?
english: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?

lokele: ¿Eya to mbo wewe wa Mungu angɛnɛ bosotaliomo tala ko l’eoka ya ewami bolimbakeli, monito imi nd’atofomo se mbo yende boto obe?
english: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

lokele: Monito iso angokelaka bobe ko mbo bolau boyeke, kwa atoonga bato bamɔi ba lisɛɔli libe mbo iso nd’asoonga ongoma? Bato ana basofakomo se ko wewe.
english: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let’s do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.

lokele: ¿Monito, iso BaYuda nd’alongeli to? Mbayo, ango sinyo! Iso nd’asotaaesa loasɔ-lo se mbo BaYuda la BaHela lisanga batotina fee bende ko nda eundelo ya bobe;
english: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin.

lokele: loisotomo nda Lokasa mbo— Angwɛnɛ oto angɔmɔi wengani,
english: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.

lokele: Angwɛnɛ woluwa, angwɛnɛ wolukaka Mungu.
english: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.

lokele: Kongo ko batotina basoengwa mboka, basoeyaeya ko wawa; Angwɛnɛ wokelaka bolau la wɛli, angɔmwito.
english: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.” Psalms 14:1-3

lokele: Kingo yau bile kwa losai elokoliolomo, Ndame yau yende la bolimbakeli; Lisäkä lia imamoa lile nda bikwekwebu yau.
english: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” Psalms 5:9 “The poison of vipers is under their lips.” Psalms 140:3

lokele: Bɛnɔkɔ yau bisotumaka la limɔli la luno.
english: “Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.” Psalms 10:7

lokele: Bakolo bau batotangwaka mangu okasendola bakila;
english: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.

lokele: Lɔsɛɛsɛlɔ la tokange bisomachomo nda mboka ebietelak’iyo.
english: Destruction and misery are in their ways.

lokele: Batiluwe mboka ya lilatemi;
english: The way of peace, they haven’t known.” Isaiah 59:7-8

lokele: Liwangi liowanga Mungu lititichomo la baiso bau.
english: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.” Psalms 36:1

lokele: Toluwi nde mbo Bikela ya Mɔsɛ bitoonga loasɔ loa ebatokanjomo la Bikela; ani bɛnɔkɔ bitotina belinjomoko la mbo bato batotina ba wenda batokomyiomo ko la Mungu kongo.
english: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.

lokele: Eoka nda baiso bande angwɛnɛ bolomboki wofomo likolo ko l’eoka yolitesa Bikela, eoka Bikela bisoesha lilembeelesi lia batwanelo. Lilendelu liolendelo Masiya Yesu litoenganesa bato
english: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

lokele: Nde kwani lienganesi lia Mungu lioenganesa bato lisoɛnɛlɛ mbo litikandomo ko la Bikela nde Lokasa loa Bikela la eya Batɔndɔli bitokambes’iso loasɔ loa liao;
english: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;

lokele: liengani lia Mungu ko l’eoka ya lilendelu lia Yesu Masiya ende batotina ebatolendelo Inde, bato batitwane,
english: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,

lokele: eoka batotina basotwanelo la basoomelo bolau wa tala ya Mungu.
english: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

lokele: Batoenganesomoko ko la booto wande, lifaefi elitofomo ko la liendoli lia Masiya Yesu.
english: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,

lokele: Mungu asɛlɛk’Inde Boendoli wa bato abe, ko la lilendelu liolendelo bakila bande. Ongoma Mungu loɛnɛsɛ liengani liande mbo ko la limɛsɛli lia batwanelo ba oso asomacha bao,
english: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice 3:25 through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;

lokele: eoka ndoɛnɛsɛ mbo Inde angɛnɛ ale liengani nda mbile-ye kwanikwani la mbo ale Wenganesi wa ebatolendelo Yesu.
english: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.

lokele: Bɔmɛtɔ wasu BaYuda anima to? Bosotunga tuu. ¿Eoka ya eni ekela to? ¿Eoka ya bekeeli yasu? Mbayo, kangä eoka ya ekela ya lilendelu.
english: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.

lokele: Eokao, tosotanga mbo boto atofomo likolo mbo engani nde, ko l’eoka ya lilendelu kongo, inga eoka ya lilitesi lia Bikela.
english: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

lokele: ¿Nde Mungu ende to wa BaYuda kongo? ¿At’imɔ ko Mungu wa tukela yasi lisanga? Eingo, imɔ ko wa tukela yasi,
english: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

lokele: ani ende ko Mungu ɔmwito, la atoenganesa ebatotena totombe loasɔ loa lilendelu la eba losunga imɔ ko la lilendelu.
english: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.

lokele: ¿Ongoma to, mbo tosoambokola Bikela ko l’eoka ya lilendelu-li? Mbayo, ango sinyo, nde tosekɔkɔmɛsɛ Bikela.
english: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.

lokele: ¿Toongeke to moni loasɔ loa Abalayama, ngau wasu, mbo aɔlɔkɔ to iye?
english: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?

lokele: Eya to mbo Abalayama aenganesomokö eoka ya bekeeli yande, limɔ ale la litina liomala, nde inga to nda baiso ba Mungu.
english: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.

lokele: ¿Lokasa loa Mungu lotoonga moni? Abalayama alendeloko ko Mungu, la lilendelu liande liatangomokö mbo liengani.
english: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.” Genesis 15:6

lokele: Likambi lia boto oyakeli likuwa lititangomo to mbo lifaefi kangä mbo likambi lia bolima;
english: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.

lokele: kongo ko boto oyatikele likuwa, nde asolendelo Inde oyatoenganesa ebatilitese Mungu, ambo lilendelu liande lisotangomo mbo liengani.
english: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.

lokele: Ongoma to Dawidi imɔ asɔsɔnɔ loasɔ loa lɔkɛmɔ loa oto oyatangomu la liengani ko la Mungu oyatitange bekeeli yande;
english: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:

lokele: Lɔkɛmɔ lole end’inde oyasomɛsɛlɔmɔ batefoli bande, la oyasofanjakomo batwanelo bande.
english: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

lokele: Lɔkɛmɔ lole end’inde ani Ngɛnɛ Mungu atitang’imɔ batwanelo bande.
english: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.” Psalms 32:1-2

lokele: ¿Lɔkɛmɔ-lo losofomo ko ende oyasotena itombe kwa ende ewa losunga imɔ? Eoka tosoonga mbo— Lilendelu lia Abalayama lisotangelomo inde mbo liengani.
english: Is this blessing then pronounced only on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.

lokele: ¿Lisotangomo mbo liengani la moni? ¿Ani atenomoko itombe kwa nda mbile ya losunga? Inga nda mbile ya itombe, kangä nda losunga.
english: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

lokele: Limɔ inde lofomo itombe kwa ndembe ndokɔkɔmɛsɛ liengani lia liimeli liande ani akatenomu itumbe mbo ayaleke Sango wa batotina ba lilendelu ani batitenomo itombe nde lisotangelomo iyo mbo liengani,
english: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.

lokele: la ale imɔ Sango wa ebatotenomo totombe inga ko l’eoka ya itombe kongo, kangä ebatotutaka imɔ boyaeli wa lilendelu lia sango wasu ako Abalayama ani akatenomu.
english: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.

lokele: Eoka lisakä eliatikomoko ende Abalayama la ende lioti liande, liko mbo elayalaka bosangoli wa tukela bitotina ya wenda, litiatikomoko ko l’eoka ya Bikela, kangä l’eoka ya liengani elisoya ko la lilendelu.
english: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

lokele: Eyambo bende eba lilitesi lia Bikela ebatosangola wenda, ani lilendelu lile to wawa la lisakä lile liyaëlä.
english: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.

lokele: Eoka Bikela nd’atoesha efango ende ebatotefokola yao; nde angwɛnɛ bikela, ambo angwɛnɛ litefoli lia yao.
english: For the law produces wrath; for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.

lokele: Eokao lisakä liatikomokö ko la lilendelu mbo likɔkɔmɛkɛ ko la booto wa Mungu kɔkɛ ende bana batotina ba Abalayama, inga ko ende ebatolitesa Bikela kongo, kangä imɔ end’iyo ebale la lilendelu kwa elia Abalayama (ale sango wasu batotina,
english: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.

lokele: kwa loatomoko mbo— Isosɛlɛ aɛ ndoyala sango wa tukela wike). Nda baiso ba Mungu ale sango wasu, alendelokö ko Mungu oyafaka loiko ende ebawi la oyatota ndola mbo ebitiyale bikinjweke yao ebile la liwawi.
english: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” Genesis 17:5 This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.

lokele: Ongoma Abalayama lokɛsɛle iyɛli ani angwɛnɛ imɔ iyɛli sha lioti, la inde lolendelo mbo eyalaka nde sango wa tukela wike, kwa aluwesomoko inde mbo— Lioti liaɛ liyalaka nde ko, ongoma.
english: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.” Genesis 15:5

lokele: La lilendelu liande litialɛlɛkɛ la bɔlɛmbu ani bindo yande yasiakowa eoka aaka la miaka kwa kama liu, la Sala atiak’imɔ botomali woota.
english: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.

lokele: Kongo ko atialɛlɛkɛ la fee nda botema loasɔ loa lisakä lia Mungu, nde inde lowangema la lilendelu, inde loinela Mungu,
english: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,

lokele: eoka aluwaka wewe mbo Mungu atokɔkɔlɔ ndokɔcha lisakä eliatikak’Inde.
english: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.

lokele: Ko la eoka-ye lilendelu liande liatangomoko mbo liengani liande.
english: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.” Genesis 15:6

lokele: Baoi-ba bako-Liatangelomoko inde, batiasɔnɔmɔkɔ ko l’eoka yande kongo,
english: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,

lokele: kangä eoka yasu imɔ lisanga; litangelomoko imɔ ko end’iso ebatolendelo Inde oyatɛmɔlɔkɔ Yesu Ngɛnɛ wasu nda liwa,
english: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,

lokele: oyaolomokö ko eoka ya batwanelo basu la oyatɛmɔlɔmɔkɔ eoka ya loenganesomu loasu.
english: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.

lokele: Aenganesomokö iso to ko la lilendelu, ongoma twende la lilatemi ende Mungu ko l’eoka ya Ngɛnɛ wasu Yesu Masiya;
english: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

lokele: ko lande tosɔɔtɛsɔmɔ nda eyaelo ya lilendelu ko nda elame ya Mungu olo asokɔkɔmɔ iso la tosoomalaka eoka ya iyɛli shoyala nda tala ya Mungu.
english: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

lokele: Inga yao kongo, kangä imɔ liomali lile lasu eoka ya bifembi yasu, eoka toluwi nde mbo bifembi bitoeshel’iso likɔkɔmɛlɛ;
english: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;

lokele: la likɔkɔmɛlɛ litoeshel’iso bofoka wolembeela bobe; la wao botoeshel’iso iyɛli sha losamɔ loa Mungu;
english: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;

lokele: la iyɛli-si siitookes’iso sɔni eoka losamɔ loa Mungu losowɛlɔmɔ nda betema yasu ko la Bolimo Botanu oyafomoko iso.
english: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

lokele: Eyayaelak’iso ko mbuwa nda lisho lioengana, Masiya lowel’iso bato ba obe.
english: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

lokele: Eoka ende tale ndowela ango oto wa liengani, nde eya boto bolau angɛnɛ, ambo ɔmɔi kotendela ndowel’inde.
english: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.

lokele: Nde Mungu lɔɛnɛkɛs’iso eloande losamɔ mbo eyayaelak’iso ko bato babe Masiya awelak’iso.
english: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

lokele: Nde simbi to kwa aenganesomu iso eoka ya lisendwi lia bakila bande, Inde nd’atouwes’iso nda efango eyetoya.
english: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.

lokele: Kwa eyayaelak’iso biyani la Mungu, liwa lia Wana wande lisootwanes’iso lande la lilatemi liasi, simbi to kwani tosootwana lande, totouwesomo ko l’eoka ya loiko loande.
english: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

lokele: Inga to la litina-li kongo, kangä imɔ mbo tosoomala la Mungu ko la Ngɛnɛ wasu Yesu Masiya oyasootwanes’iso kwani liasi la lilatɛmi. Bobe wa Adamu bosofanjomo la Liendoli lia Yesu
english: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

lokele: Eokao, kwa ayaka bobe nda wenda-bo ko l’eoka ya bolomboki ɔmɔi kongo, la liwa imɔ loasɔ loa bobe, ko ongoma liwa lisoyaka ende bato, boto la boto, eoka batotina basotwanelo.
english: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.

lokele: Bobe wayalaka nde nda wenda oso wa Bikela, kongo ko bobe botitangomo ende bato ani Bikela bititayalaka.
english: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

lokele: Nde liwa liakakalesäkä wenda ko nda Adamu, boto wa oso, konda Mɔsɛ, ango wokakalesa ebatiakelaka bɔfɔnɔ ona wa obe ewakelaka Adamu, oyaaka ndembe ya Inde oyakayeke.
english: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

lokele: Kongo ko litwanelo lina litikweele lifaefi liko liengani eoka ango wike basowa eoka ya litwanelo lia boto ɔmɔi, nde booto wa Mungu la lifaefi lia booto wa boto ona ako Yesu Masiya bosoelwaka finɛ ende bato wike.
english: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.

lokele: La lifaefi lina litikweele fendelo ya litwanelo lia boto ɔmɔi ona; eoka litwanelo eliafaka boto ɔmɔi se litiengane la lifaefi lifi elitoesha lienganesi lia batwanelo wike.
english: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.

lokele: Eoka ya litwanelo lia boto ɔmɔi liwa lisolongela ko la boto ona, nde simbi to ebasɔɔlɔ lilya lia booto la lifaefi lia lienganesi liande, belalengaka la loiko eoka ya Boto ɔmɔi ako Yesu Masiya.
english: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

lokele: Ongoma, eoka ya litwanelo lia boto ɔmɔi, bato batotina basofomo se, ko ongoma lienganesi lia boto ɔmɔi lisofaka batotina likolo, lisoemes’iyo liasi, ambo nda loiko loa liengani.
english: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.

lokele: Eoka ya litefoli lia boto ɔmɔi, bato wike basoyalesomo eba batwanelo, ongoma ko l’eoka ya lilitesi lia Boto Ɔmɔi bato wike batoyalesomo eba liengani.
english: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

lokele: Nde Bikela bisoyatuta ko mbisa ko ndokondesa litwanelo, kongo ko akondaka litwanelo, ongoma booto imɔ akondakondaka likama,
english: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,

lokele: ani ayalaka bobe bokakalesi amamwito la liwa, ko ongoma booto bosokakalesa bato la lienganesi lioeshaka loiko loa layalaya buu ko la Yesu Masiya Ngɛnɛ wasu.
english: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

lokele: ¿Toongeke to moni, mbo— Totikakaleke nda batwanelo basu mbo booto bulwesomoko?
english: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

lokele: Mbayo, ango sinyo! Iso tosowanjwa nda batwanelo kwa ebasowela bao; ¿Totoyalaka to nda bao la moni?
english: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?

lokele: ¿Otiluweke mbo iso yaatotina ebasolufiomo ende Masiya Yesu, tosolufiomo imɔ nda liwa liande?
english: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

lokele: Ongoma to tosoombomo amamwito lande nda kito ko la lilufi, mbo, kwa atɛmwɛsɔmɔkɔ Masiya nda liwa ko l’eoka ya tala ya Sango wande, ko ongoma iso imɔ kotutaka boyaeli boyai wa loiko.
english: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

lokele: Ango iso tosowatemaka lande la liwa kwa eliande angɛnɛ, ongoma iso kowatemaka lande nda litɛmwi liande.
english: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

lokele: Tosoluwa mbo boyaeli wasu wa oso bosoolomo amamwito lande nda lieka mbo bindo ya batwanelo bisɛɛsɛlɛsɔmɔkɔ mbo totayala imɔ bɛkɔwa ya bobe.
english: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.

lokele: Oyasowa at’imɔ la loasɔ lokuwela bobe ewakakalesak’inde.
english: For he who has died has been freed from sin.

lokele: Ango tosowa amamwito la Masiya, ambo tosoimela mbo totoyalana lande nda loiko;
english: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,

lokele: eoka tosoluwa mbo Masiya oyatɛmwɛsɔmɔkɔ nda liwa, atiawek’imɔ liasi, liwa litiakakalesek’Inde imɔ liasi.
english: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!

lokele: Eoka awaka nde ndowa loasɔ loa bobe, angowel’imɔ wao liasi, kongo ko loiko elosoyala lande lole oko l’eoka ya Mungu.
english: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.

lokele: Ino imɔ ko ongoma, luwaka mbo osowela bobe, kongo ko wende la loiko loasɔ loa Mungu ko la Masiya Yesu.
english: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

lokele: Bobe bokakalesëke to bindo yanu ebitowa mbo otalitesa yɛmɛ ibe ya yao;
english: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

lokele: Ofaefëke bilengo yanu nda bobe ndoyalaka biɛla ya obe yonana la bolau, kongo ko faefaka betema yanu ende Mungu kwa ebasotɛmwa nda liwa la bilengo yanu biyaleke biengo yokelaka likuwa eliengani elia Mungu.
english: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.

lokele: Eoka bobe boitokakales’ino imɔ liasi, eoka oti’mɔ bɛkɔwa ya Bikela, kangä eya Booto wa Mungu. Ikweelo sha Bɔkɔwa
english: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.

lokele: ¿Moni to, tokeleke bobe, ko l’eoka mbo tot’imɔ nda isosha sha Bikela, kangä esha booto? Mbayɔ, ango sinyo!
english: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!

lokele: Otiluweke mbo bokulya ndoyalaka bɛkɔwa ya oto ndolites’inde, ambo wende bɔkɔwa wa boto oyatokakales’ino; angoko bɔkɔwa wa bobe, ndokawa; angoko bɔkɔwa wa lilitesi, ndokaenganaka?
english: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?

lokele: Nde kelekëlë ende Mungu eoka mbo ino ewayalaka oso bɛkɔwa ya bobe, nde kwani osolitesa la betema betotina ko Liekesi elisüchomu ino;
english: But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.

lokele: la asosɔmbɔlɔmɔ ino nda eundelo ya bobe, osoya bɛkɔwa ya liengani kwani.
english: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.

lokele: Isoonga la bɔfɔno-bo wa loasɔ loa bato, ko l’eoka mbo wende sumbu la bɔlɛmbu. Kwa afaefaka to ino bilengo yanu mbo biyaleke bɛkɔwa ya bɔlɛlɔ la litefoli, ko ongoma kwani faefaka bilengo yanu ndoyalaka bɛkɔwa ya liengani liotanesomo tanelele.
english: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.

lokele: Eoka ayalak’ino bɛkɔwa ya bobe, otiakakalesomoko la liengani.
english: For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.

lokele: ¿Nda mbile ena, waɔlɔkɔ̈ to boni bosombo wa njasɔ ina ebisok’ino ko sɔni kwani? Bina bitotungama ngo ko nda liwa.
english: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

lokele: Nde asosɔmbɔlɔmɔ ino kwani nda bobe, osoya bɛkɔwa ya Mungu otɔɔlɔkɔ bosombo boko lotanekeso loa bobe, lototungama ngo ko nda loiko loa layalaya.
english: But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.

lokele: Eoka liɔli lia bɔkɔwa wa bobe ende ko liwa; kongo ko lifaefi lia booto wa Mungu lile loiko loa layalaya bu ko la Masiya Yesu Ngɛnɛ wasu.
english: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

lokele: Bitungani yami, isofel’ino ebaluwi nde Bikela, mbo— ¿Oisoluwa mbo ekela etokanjaka boto ko nda mbile eyekoyali inde la liwawi?
english: Or don’t you know, brothers 7:1 (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?

lokele: Eoka otomali oyale wali wa boto, akoyali botolome la liwawi, liti lisokufes’inde ndosɛnyana la olome. Nde bolome ewa, limɔ botomali asosɔmbɔlɔmɔ nda liti lia botolome.
english: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.

lokele: Ongoma to, ani olome akoyali, wali ɛsɔngɔnɔ la botolome wasi, inde kotangomo ewa nyongo; nde olome ewa, wali asosɔmbɔlɔmɔ nda liti, limɔ ɛsɔngɔnɔ la botolome wasi, at’imɔ ewa nyongo.
english: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.

lokele: Bitungani yami, ko ongoma end’ino, osokwela se nda Bikela ani osowatema la liwa lia bindo ya Masiya, mbo oomaneke la Wasi oyasosokwa nda liwa mbo tooteleke Mungu lioti lia eula.
english: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.

lokele: Ayalak’iso ko la boyaeli wa bindo kongo, yɛmɛ ya bindo eyaluwak’iso ko l’eoka ya Bikela, yao lofumbekes’iso nda bilengo yasu ko ndoota lioti elikatungeke ko la liwa;
english: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.

lokele: nde kwani tososɔmbɔlɔmɔ liti eliakandak’iso eoka tosowela liao mbo totayala imɔ bɛkɔwa ya bikela ya oso eyasɔnɔmɔkɔ, kangä bɛkɔwa ya Bolimo boyai. ¿Mbo Bikela yende Bibe?
english: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.

lokele: ¿Toongeke to moni, mbo— Bikela yende ko bibe? Ango sinyo! Aenaka Bikela, ani itiluweke litina lia batwanelo. Aenaka Bikela mbo— Ololëke, ani itiluweke mbo bolole bole bobe.
english: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.” Exodus 20:17

lokele: Nde bobe bosoɛnɛ fofe ko la liti, limɔ bosofɔɔlɔ’mi ndolola la yɛmɛ finɛ. Aenaka to liti, ani bobe bot’imo.
english: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.

lokele: Imi nd’ayalaka oso shɛi la Bikela, nde ayaka Bikela limɔ Bobe lowawa la imi lowa;
english: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived and I died.

lokele: la liti lioluwesa mboka ya loiko, imi lɔɛnɛ ko liao mbo mboka ya liwa kongo.
english: The commandment which was for life, this I found to be for death;

lokele: Nde bobe bosɔɛnɛ fofe ko la liti yolimbaka’mi, limɔ liti lisoola’mi ko ndofa’mi se.
english: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.

lokele: Ongoma to Bikela bisüchomo ende Mungu, la liti lisüchomo imɔ, lile la liengani la bolau.
english: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, righteous, and good.

lokele: ¿Loende to loasɔ lolau elotoeshela’mi liwa? Mbayo, ango sinyo! Kangä bobe angɛnɛ ko la mboka ya bolau bosoeshela’mi liwa mbo bobe wɛnɛlɛ wewe ko mbo bobe la mbo wao bolembeelomoko mbo bobe woeta ko la liti.
english: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.

lokele: Toluwi nde mbo Bikela bile ngo ko ya Bolimo, nde imi angɛnɛ yende ko boto wa bindo, la isotambesomo kwa bɔkɔwa wa Bobe oyatokakalesa’mi.
english: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.

lokele: Itiluwe to litina lia bekeeli yami, eoka iitokelaka yao ebitosanga’mi okela; nde isokela ko yao ebisokaka’mi efu.
english: For I don’t understand what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.

lokele: Yekela to yao ebitisange’mi okela, ambo isoaola mbo liti lile lilau finɛ.
english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.

lokele: Kwani ati to imi angɛnɛ oyatokela bobe, kangä Bobe eboingali atiteni yami.
english: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

lokele: Eokao, iluwi nde mbo nda bindo yami, biko lokomba angɛnɛ, angwɛnɛ bolau boyali nd’ina, eoka yende la lisangi liosanga bolau, nde iti ango la bofoka wokelaka wao.
english: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.

lokele: Eoka itikele bolau ebososanga’mi okela, kangä bobe ebotisange’m wao angɛnɛ imi nd’asokelaka.
english: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.

lokele: Eya to mbo imi yekela wao ebotisange’mi, ambo ati to’mi oyakeli, kangä Bobe oyaingali lami.
english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

lokele: Isoosha to litina lia boyaeli-bo, mbo ani asosanga’mi okela bolau, limɔ bobe botoyalakana lami tina.
english: I find then the law that, while I desire to do good, evil is present.

lokele: Isoomalaka to nda botema wami loasɔ loa Bikela ya Mungu,
english: For I delight in God’s law after the inward person,

lokele: kongo ko isɔɛnɛ bikela yasi nda bilengo yami bitonanaka la botema wami la ebitoundesa’mi kakau nda bikela ya Bobe, ebile nda bilengo yami.
english: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.

lokele: Imi yende bolomboki nda tale finɛ! ¿Ndai to atɔɔnokɔlɔ’mi nda bindo-bi ebisoundomo la liwa?
english: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?

lokele: Kelekëlë ende Mungu, ko la Yesu Masiya Ngɛnɛ wasu! Imi angɛnɛ to nda botema yende bɔkɔwa wa Bikela ya Mungu, nde bindo bile bɔkɔwa wa bikela ya Bobe.
english: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.

lokele: Eokao ebasowatemaka la Yesu Masiya baitofomo imɔ se,
english: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit. 8:1

lokele: eoka bikela ya Bolimo wa Loiko ebole la Masiya Yesu bisofaikola’mi nda bikela ya bobe la liwa.
english: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

lokele: Loasɔ elotikɔkɔlɛ to Bikela ndokela, eoka yende la bɔlɛmbu wa bindo, Mungu angɛnɛ nd’akelaka loko ndotoma Wana wande nda bindo ya bɔfɔnɔ wa bato babe ko ndowa eoka ya bobe la ndofaka bobe wa bindo se;
english: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,

lokele: mbo bakakanelo ba Bikela bakɔchɔmɔkɔ lasu ebatikɛndɛsɔmɔkɔ la yɛmɛ ya bindo, kangä ko la Bolimo.
english: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

lokele: Ebatolitesa yɛmɛ ya bindo, batoenyakela ko njasɔ ya bindo, ebatolitesa eya bolimo, batoenyakela ko eya bolimo.
english: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.

lokele: Eoka ndoenyakela ko bindo, ende ko liwa; nde ndoenyakela bolimo, ende loiko la lilatemi.
english: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;

lokele: Baenyakeli ba bindo basoiyana la Mungu, baitolitekesa Bikela ya Mungu, eoka batikɔkɔlɛ okela ongoma;
english: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.

lokele: ebatoyalaka ko bindo batikɔkɔlɛ ndoomalesa Mungu.
english: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.

lokele: Kongo ko ino ba Masiya ot’imɔ wokakalesomo la yɛmɛ ya bindo, kangä eya Bolimo, eya to mbo Bolimo wa Mungu boyalaka end’ino. Oyati la Bolimo wa Masiya, ambo ati wande.
english: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.

lokele: Nde eya to mbo Masiya eyala atiteni yanu, bindo ewa ndowa eoka ya bobe, kongo ko belimo yanu bitoyala la liwawi ko l’eoka ya liengani.
english: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.

lokele: Eya to mbo Bolimo oyatɛmɔlɔkɔ Yesu nda liwa eyalaka atiteni yanu, ambo Oyatɛmɔlɔkɔ Masiya Yesu nda liwa, efaefaka bindo yanu liwawi liasi ko la Bolimo oyatoyalaka atiteni yanu. Tole bana ba Mungu
english: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.

lokele: Eokao, Bitungani yami, lole loasu mbo toyaleke kwa alɛmbi Bolimo inga kwa alɛmbi ko bindo;
english: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

lokele: eoka eya mbo boyalaka kwa alɛmbi bindo yanu limɔ bowaka nde; kongo ko eya mbo bosingesa yɛmɛ ya bindo ko la Bolimo ambo boyalaka la loiko.
english: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

lokele: Eoka batotina ebasotolomo oso ko la Bolimo wa Mungu, bende bana ba Mungu;
english: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.

lokele: eoka otifomo bolimo wa bɛkɔwa mbo winweke liasi nda bɔwa, kangä bolimo wa bana angɛnɛ (ebayalaka bɛkɔwa oso) la ko la bolimo tosoamama mbo— Abba, Sango wasu!
english: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! 8:15 Father!”

lokele: Bolimo angɛnɛ asotaka boekï amamwito la ewasu bolimo mbo tole bana ba Mungu;
english: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;

lokele: toyala bana, ambo iso kosangola botiko wa Mungu Sango amamwito la Boloo wasu ako Masiya, eya tɔɔlɔ likaɔ lia bemusi yande mbo tɔɔlɛkɛ imɔ likaɔ lia linɛngina lia tala yande. Liuwesi liyaka nde mbisa ya bemusi
english: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

lokele: Isoenyela mbo bemusi ya mbile-ye bitiengane ango sinyo la tala ebilɛnɛsɔmɔkɔ end’iso mbisa.
english: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

lokele: Yeka bitotina ebikelomu la Mungu, bisoumbakelaka la baiso nda mboka wɛnɛ lɔɛnɛsɔ loa bana ba Mungu;
english: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

lokele: yeka ina bitotina yayalaka ko liyaëlä kongo, inga la yɛmɛ ya yao angɛnɛ, kangä la lisangi lia Inde oyakanjaka yao la iyɛli sha Bouwesi,
english: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope

lokele: mbo bitotina eyakelomoko bitosɔmbɔlɔmɔ nda ekanjelo ya lɔfɔndɔ ndoyalaka toote twa Mungu etwa bɔfɛkɔ wa tala yande.
english: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.

lokele: Toluwi nde mbo bitotina ebiyali ono se bitosumasuma nda toelo twa mbota ko nda mbile-ye;
english: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

lokele: inga yao kongo, kangä imɔ ko iso lisanga ebasofomo eula ya oso ya Bolimo, tososumasuma nda betema ani tosowɛlɛkɛ baiso mbo tosɛlɔmɔkɔ bana ba Mungu ko la liendolomu lia bindo yasu.
english: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.

lokele: Eoka tosouwesomo ko la iyɛli; nde iyɛli esisɔɛnɛ yao eyetoumbakel’iso, sit’imɔ iyɛli; ndai kokɛsɛlɛ iyɛli sha yao eyɛn’inde?
english: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?

lokele: Kongo ko toumbakela la iyɛli yeka eyetiɛnɛlɛ, iso kowɛlɛ yao baiso la likɔkɔmɛlɛ elitiwe esole. Mungu atosungak’iso la Bolimo la Wana wande
english: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.

lokele: Ongoma Bolimo botokɔkɔmɛs’iso la lisungi liande nda bɔlɛmbu ebole lasu; eoka totiluwe ndosombola la wɛlï, nde Bolimo angɛnɛ atosombokoel’iso la besumo ebitiokane baoi.
english: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.

lokele: Nde Oyatolukaka ebiisami nda betema, aluwi nde baenyeli ba Bolimo eoka atosomboela ebüchomoko la Mungu ko la lisangi lia Mungu.
english: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.

lokele: Toluwi nde mbo nda njasɔ bitotina Mungu nd’atokɔkɔmɛsɛ bolau ende batotina ebasami nd’Inde, bako ebasotomo lioi lande la lisangi liande;
english: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

lokele: eoka Mungu aluwaka nde ebasɛlɛk’Inde mbo bafaefomoko bofɔɔnɔ ebole la Wana wande mbo Inde ako Wana ayaleke ko wana wa oso wa bitungani wike.
english: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers. 8:29

lokele: Limɔ, ebasangak’Inde oso, Inde lotak’iyo lioi, limɔ ebatomoko lioi, Inde loenganes’iyo, la ebenganesomoko lande, iyo lotaliomoko lande tala.
english: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

lokele: ¿Totoonga to moni eoka ya njasɔ-bi? ¿Mungu eyalaka lasu, ndai to kofekel’iso?
english: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

lokele: Inde kongo oyatifekel’iso Wana wande angɛnɛ, nde Oyamach’Inde ndoyawel’iso yaatotina, ¿aitofaef’iso imɔ ko bitotina bofäfä?
english: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?

lokele: ¿Ndai atowanjela ebaaomu la Mungu? Ende Mungu oyasotang’iyo mbo bengani;
english: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.

lokele: ¿Ndai kof’iyo se? Ende Masiya Yesu oyawaka, eingo oyatɛmwaka imɔ, oyale nda fangi ya olome ya Mungu la oyatoongel’iso.
english: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

lokele: ¿Ndai atosenyanes’iso shei la losamɔ loa Masiya? ¿Mbo bomusi, kwa tale, kwa likongolomu, kwa londo, kwa boeno wa bisinda, kwa bifembi, kwa bita?
english: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

lokele: Loatomoko nda Lokasa ongoma mbo— Tosoolomo ko la nɔngɔ buse tu ko loasɔ loaɛ, tosotangomo mbo bɛkɔkɔ yoolomo.
english: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.” Psalms 44:22

lokele: Kongo ko nda bitotina-bi tosolonga ndolonga fɛɛ ko la bofoka wa Inde Oyasami nd’iso.
english: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

lokele: Iluwi to ndoluwa mbo loti la loasɔ, ango liwa, ango liwawi, ango bakitomo, ango eba tososha, ango eya mbile-ye, ango ebikayeke, ango befoka,
english: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

lokele: ango botalemu wa use, ango bolundu wa balia, ango yeka ya kanda yasi, angwɛnɛ eyetokɔkɔlɔ ndosenyanes’iso shei la losamɔ loa Mungu elosoomana tɔɔ la Masiya Yesu Ngɛnɛ wasu.
english: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

lokele: Nda lina lia Masiya isoonga wewe, itite lolanga, mbo eluwanelo yami ya olau la obe etokulia lioi liami ko la Bolimo Botanu liko mbo—
english: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit

lokele: Ile la ikɛnɛnɛ sifi la bomusi ebotimacheke botema wami.
english: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.

lokele: Isikiosombola mbo imi isendomoko bieo yosenyanesomo shei la Masiya loasɔ loa bitungani yami ya tukela yasu;
english: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh

lokele: bende BaIsalaele, basotangomo bana ba Mungu; tala ya eyaelo ya Mungu la ngɛla yande la likomyi lia Bikela yande la lisemoli liande la basakä bande, bitotina bisoomana lau;
english: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;

lokele: bangau bende ebau, la Masiya ende wa tukela yau nda loasɔ loa bindo, oyatalemi likolo lia yaatotina ako Mungu, ainelomoko ko nda layalaya, ongoma.
english: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.

lokele: Loti to mbo Lioi lia Mungu end’iyo lisowa liwela, eoka batotina ba tukela ya Isalaele batiomane wewe la Isalaele,
english: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.

lokele: batotina bati bana ba Abalayama ko l’eoka ya lioti liande, kangä mbo— Ko la Isaka kongo lioti litotangomo eliaɛ.
english: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.” Genesis 21:12

lokele: Litina mbo bati to bana ba lioti lia bindo ebatangomu bana ba Mungu, kangä bana ba lisakä batangomu lioti liande.
english: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.

lokele: Baoi ba lisakä-li bende mbo— Nda mbile-ye la mwaka wa mbisa, yeyaka nde, la Sala eotaka wana otolome.
english: For this is a word of promise: “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.” Genesis 18:10

lokele: Inga to loasɔ lona kongo, kangä imɔ ko Lebeka oyayalaka la lieme ko la sango wasu ako Isaka,
english: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.

lokele: eoka ani bana bakaotomu kɔni, l’ani batitakelaka loasɔ ango lolau angoko lobe, mbo likomyi lia Mungu lioaa bana likɔchomoko,
english: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls, 9:11

lokele: inga eoka yolitesa bikela, kangä eoka yota oto lioi. Lebeka lokambesomo mbo— Boloo atokuwela etungani;
english: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.” Genesis 25:23

lokele: kwa loatomoko nda Lokasa ongoma mbo— Yasamaka nde Yakobo, nde itiluweke Esau. Lofekelomo loa Isalaele loti loasɔ loa Mungu
english: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.” Malachi 1:2-3

lokele: ¿Toongeke to moni, mbo— Angwɛnɛ to liengani ende Mungu? Mbayo, ango sinyo!
english: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!

lokele: Mungu loonga la Mɔsɛ mbo— Itowɛlɛ booto ende boto kwa alɛmbi nde’mi, la itowela boto shota kwa alɛmbi nde’mi.
english: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.” Exodus 33:19

lokele: Eokao to loti loasɔ loa lisangi angoko loa lifumbi lia boto, kangä loa booto wa Mungu.
english: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.

lokele: Lokasa loa Mungu loonga la Bɔkɔta Falao mbo— Isoemes’aɛ la tala, ko la litina-li, liko mbo yɛnɛsɛkɛ bato bofoka wami la mbo lina liami liluwesomoko nda yese bitotina.
english: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.” Exodus 9:16

lokele: Ongoma to mbo— Mungu atowɛlɛ booto ende boto kwa alɛmbi nd’Inde la atosɛlɛ boto la lotale oyakalɛmbɛk’Inde.
english: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.

lokele: Ango bofela’mi mbo— ¿Monito Mungu atofaka kɔni bato liɛngɔ? Ndai to kofekel’Inde lisangi liande?
english: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”

lokele: ¿Aɛ bolomboki wende to ndai oyatofenyana la Mungu tofenya? ¿Yeka eyekokelemu koonga la oyakokel’mde mbo— Okokeli’mi anyo moni?
english: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?” Isaiah 29:16

lokele: ¿Bokuki-tei ati l’isosha shokela la ibɔ simwitɔ sha ilɔngɔ ango tei ya bɔfɛkɔ, ango ko tei ya bɔkɛcha?
english: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?

lokele: ¿Mungu ɛlɛmbɛ to ndwɛnɛsɛ bato efango yande loasɔ loa bobe la ndoluwesa bato bofoka wande bofi, la eombakela la bofiili bofi ko tei ina ebikukiomu la bɔkɛcha ndosɛɛsɛlɛsɔmɔ la efango,
english: What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,

lokele: ko la litina mbo aluweseke bondanda wa tala yande ebotowɛlɛk’Inde nda tei ya booto ebisotakomia Inde eoka ya bɔfɛkɔ,
english: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory—

lokele: bako iso angɛnɛ ebatomoko lioi, inga BaYuda kongo kangä imɔ eba yese yasi?
english: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?

lokele: Kwa aongak’Inde nda Lokasa loa Hosea mbo— Ebatiaaka bato bami, imi yetak’iyo mbo bato bami; La oyatiasamomoko, yetak’inde mbo bosamomu.
english: As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.” Hosea 2:23

lokele: Limɔ nda elela olo aongomoko mbo— Ino oti bato bami, Ko omao betangomoko nde mbo Bana ba Mungu wa loiko.
english: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’” Hosea 1:10

lokele: Yesaya lota boekï loasɔ loa BaIsalaele mbo— Ango loketi loa bana ba Isalaele loyala wike kwa eloa nyɛlɛ yoke nda balia, ko bosandelo se wau kongo bouwesomoko;
english: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;

lokele: eoka Mungu atokɔchaka lioi liande chaa la atotenaka likomyi liande shɔɔ nda wenda.
english: for he will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the Lord will make a short work upon the earth.” Isaiah 10:22-23

lokele: Kwa atɔndɔlɔkɔ̈ imɔ Yesaya mbo— Aenaka mbo Mungu wa bikuke amachelak’iso koto ya bosandelose, Ani tosokinjwaka kwa Sodoma, ani tosokelomo bɔfɔɔnɔ wa Gomola.
english: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies 9:29 had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.” Isaiah 1:9

lokele: ¿Toongeke to moni? Mbo bato ba wenda ebatiaengaka liengani, iyo basoosha liengani, liko liengani elisoya ko l’eoka ya lilendelu;
english: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn’t follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;

lokele: kongo ko BaIsalaele ebaengaka liengani lia lilitesi lia Bikela, iyo batiosheke liao.
english: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.

lokele: ¿Basoomelo la moni? Eoka baengaka liao, inga ko la lilendelu, kangä ko la bekeeli ya Bikela; basokwa ilango nda litalɛ lia likulya, kwa loatomoko nda Lokasa mbo— Tɛnɛngo! Nda Siona isota litalɛ liokwesa bato likulya, Ango lituka liokwes’iso ilango; Kongo ko oyatolendelo Inde aitookesomo sɔni.
english: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,

lokele: Bitungani yami, yende la limɛngɔ finɛ nda botema la nda lisomboli liami eoka ya bato, bako BaIsalaele, mbo buwesomoko,
english: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.

lokele: eoka isoaola wewe mbo bende la bofimbi finɛ wolitesaka Mungu, nde angwɛnɛ liluwani to.
english: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.

lokele: Eoka batialuwaka liengani lia Mungu, nde basoluka mboka yokɔkɔmɛsɛ liengani eliau angɛnɛ la batilitese liengani lia Mungu.
english: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.

lokele: Eoka Masiya nd’atokɔcha Bikela ndoenganesa batotina ebasolendelo Inde.
english: For Christ is the fulfillment 10:4 of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.

lokele: Mɔsɛ nd’asɔnɔkɔ mbo boto oyatokɔcha Bikela ko la bekeeli inde atoɔlɔ loiko.
english: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.” Leviticus 18:5

lokele: Nde liengani elia lilendelu lisoonga mbo— Oongëke nda botema waɛ mbo, ¿Ndai atolila ko nda use? (eoka ndokasulola Masiya se), oongëke mbo—
english: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ Deuteronomy 30:12 (that is, to bring Christ down);

lokele: ¿Ndai atokwaka se mbi nda olundu wa ewelo? (ndokatɛmɔlɔ Masiya nda liwa).
english: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ Deuteronomy 30:13 (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”

lokele: Nde losoonga to moni? Mbo liölo lile tina laɛ, nda bɔnɔkɔ waɛ la nda botema waɛ, la liölo lina lile elia lilendelu elisotomo lasu boekï,
english: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart;” Deuteronomy 30:14 that is, the word of faith which we preach:

lokele: mbo eyambo boaola la bɔnɔkɔ waɛ mbo Yesu ale Ngɛnɛ, la boimela nda botema waɛ mbo Mungu asotɛmɔlɔ Inde nda liwa, ani buwesomoko.
english: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

lokele: Eoka boto atoimela la botema ko ndoenganesomo, la atoaola ko la bɔnɔkɔ ko ndouwesomo.
english: For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation.

lokele: Lokasa loa Mungu mbo— Batotina ebatolendelo Inde baitookesomo sɔni.
english: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.” Isaiah 28:16

lokele: Batitwane to, bako BaYuda la BaHela, eoka Ngɛnɛ ɔmwito ale ko Ngɛnɛ wa yaatotina, oyale to la bofäfä ende batotina ebatosingwaka lina liande.
english: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.

lokele: Eoka mbo— Batotina ebatosingwaka lina lia Ngɛnɛ belauwesomoko.
english: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.” Joel 2:32

lokele: ¿Nde batosingwaka lina liande moni ani bakimel’Inde? ¿Batoimel’Inde to moni ani bakoki wɛndi wande? ¿Batoka wɛndi wande moni, ani batitatomo boekï?
english: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?

lokele: ¿Boekï atotaka wɛndi sakolo ngo ko asotomomo la moni? Kwa asɔnɔmɔkɔ nda Lokasa mbo— Aina bolau mbo basoyanangoel’iso mboli ilau!
english: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!” Isaiah 52:7

lokele: Kongo ko batotina batialailaka mboli ilau la wɛlï, eoka Yesaya aongaka mbo— ¿Ngɛnɛ, ndai asoimela wɛndi wasu?
english: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?” Isaiah 53:1

lokele: Ongoma to, liimeli lisoya ko la lioki lia wɛndi la lioki lia wɛndi ko la inango sha Masiya.
english: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

lokele: Kongo ko imi mbo— ¿Mbo bakoki to? Eingo nde— Bamiki bau basoiyela yese bitotina la tonango twau ko nda bako ba wenda.
english: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.” Psalms 19:4

lokele: Imi mbo— ¿BaIsalaele angoluwa la wɛlï to? Mɔsɛ nd’aongaka ko kwaala mbo— Imi nd’atookes’ino bokelë loasɔ loa bato ebati ango tukela, Itosomes’ino ko loasɔ loa bato ba mbuwa la bibebe.
english: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation. I will make you angry with a nation void of understanding.” Deuteronomy 32:21

lokele: Yesaya nde lotendela ndoonga mbo— Isooshana l’ebatilukeke’mi; isɔɛnɛlɛ ende bato ebatifeleke’mi.
english: Isaiah is very bold and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.” Isaiah 65:1

lokele: Limɔ inde loonga l’eba Isalaele mbo— Ko nɔngɔ buse tuu isonanoel’ino besamba yami la losamɔ, End’ino bato ba tukela ya litefokoli la tofenya.
english: But about Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.” Isaiah 65:2

lokele: Itofela to mbo— ¿Mungu asofeka to bato ba tukela yande? Mbayo! Imi imɔ yende wa Isalaele, yende wa lioti lia Abalayama, wa bofindi wa Benyamina.
english: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

lokele: Mungu atifeke bato bande ebaluwanaka lande ko oso. ¿Ango otiluwe elotoonga Lokasa loa Mungu loasɔ loa Eliya? Inde lokatata eoka ya BaIsalaele ende Mungu mbo—
english: God didn’t reject his people, whom he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:

lokele: Ngɛnɛ Mungu, Basoola batɔndɔli baɛ, basoukola bitambelo yaɛ, la itikali ko imi kongo la batoluka fofe ndoyaola’mi.
english: “Lord, they have killed your prophets. They have broken down your altars. I am left alone, and they seek my life.” 1 Kings 19:10

lokele: ¿Nde limutoli lia Mungu end’inde lile moni? Mungu mbo— Bakotikali ende’mi bato bilɛfu bosambale ebatiswe balui se ndosemola Baala.
english: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.” 1 Kings 19:18

lokele: Ko ongoma imɔ nda mbile-ye botüku bosandelu nde se ebosoaomo ko la booto wa Mungu.
english: Even so too at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

lokele: Eya to mbo ko la booto, ambo inga eoka ya bekeeli yau; aenaka ongoma, ani booto botifomo lifaefela.
english: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.

lokele: ¿Limɔ to moni? Isalaele loomelo lona eloalukak’inde, nde botüku ona ebosoaomo la Mungu iyo lofomo loao, kongo ko ebamɔi lowa bɔsɛnɔ finɛ.
english: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.

lokele: Kwa asɔnɔmɔkɔ nda Lokasa mbo— Mungu asowɛlɛk’iyo bolengelenge nda baiso mbo batɛnɛ la mbo batoka la batoi, ko nda eweuse.
english: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.” Deuteronomy 29:4

lokele: La Dawidi imɔ mbo— Mɛsa olo atolak’iyo elambɔ ekinjweke ilonga, kwa elöngo; Mbo bakweke tolango tokundel’iyo likundo,
english: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.

lokele: Baiso bau batufatufeke mbo batɛnɛ la wɛli Ani bɛkɔngɔ yau beinyakameke mbile la mbile.
english: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Always keep their backs bent.” Psalms 69:22

lokele: Eokao, imi mbo— ¿Basokwa ilango sha lifongolitule angoemal’imɔ liasi? Mbayo, ango sinyo! Kongo ko, ko la litwanelo liau, liuwesi lisoya ende eba tukela yasi mbo BaYuda bokesomoko bokelë.
english: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.

lokele: Eya to mbo litwanelo liau lisofotesa eba wenda bototina, la ilango shau sisofotesa tukela yasi, nde simbi to ani Bayuda batotina basoimela.
english: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!

lokele: Isoonga to nde ende eba tukela yasi, eoka kwa ayali nde imi botomomo ende eba tukela yasi, isotalia sumbu likuwa liami tala,
english: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,

lokele: mbo yefɔlɔ sumbu bokelë wa eba lioti liami angɛnɛ la mbo bamɔi bau buwesomoko.
english: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.

lokele: Eoka eya mbo lofeko loau lootwanesa eba wenda la Mungu liasi, ongoma lonyangelomo loau loisoeshela eloeta, loko mbo loiko losokwa nda liwa?
english: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?

lokele: Eya to bɔtɔ̈mɔ wa lituma büchomo ende Mungu, simbi to litotina koküchomo; eya mbo wili büchomo, simbi to beta imɔ ko ongoma.
english: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.

lokele: Ango beta bimɔi beunakomo nda isandu, limɔ aɛ ako bota w’isandu sha lokonda kɔtɛsɔmɔ nda lifa lia yao ya bokuma, limɔ beta bitotina koyala la wili ɔmwito, kokaana bofoka wa bülu w’isandu, otakemëke loasɔ loa beta.
english: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree,

lokele: Nde botakema nda loasɔ-lo, luwaka mbo aɛ otisuche wili, kangä wili nd’atokɔkɔmɛsɛ aɛ.
english: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, remember that it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.

lokele: Boonga to mbo— Beta lounakomo mbo imi yɔtɛsɔmɔkɔ nda lifa lia yao.
english: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”

lokele: Bolau to, nde yao lounakomo eoka basolengela lilendelu, aɛ angɛnɛ osokɔkɔmɔ ko l’eoka ya lilendelu. Eokao oyalëke la bɔmɛtɔ, kangä la bɔwa.
english: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;

lokele: Eoka eya to Mungu angomɛsɛlɛ beta eyakondaka nda isandu angɛnɛ, asa kɔni Inde angomɛsɛlɛ aɛ.
english: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.

lokele: Tɛnɛkɛ to booto wa Mungu la imɔ ko efango yande; atotulunga ebasokwa se, nde end’aɛ ko booto wa Mungu ani otokɔkɔmɔ nda booto wande, nde aenaka ongoma ani aɛ kotinyomo.
english: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.

lokele: Ebamɔi imɔ bemachaka litefoli liau, iyo koɔtɛsɔmɔ ndowachomo nda isandu eoka Mungu atokɔkɔlɔ ndowach’iyo nda bokuma liasi.
english: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

lokele: Eya to mbo aɛ watinyomo nda isandu sha lokonda ndokawachomo nda bokuma wa isandu sha tuma, eoka ongoma ende efinole, simbi to beta ina kowachomo nda isandu sha yao angɛnɛ.
english: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?

lokele: Kongo ko, bitungani, itilɛmbɛ mbo oyaleke botutuku nda loasɔ-lo eloisami sumbu litina, mbo otayala la bɔmɛtɔ, eoka boseno wa betema bosounda sumbu BaIsalaele ko nda akɔtɛkɛ eba tukela yasi ndɔɔlɔlɛsɛ lisangi lia Mungu,
english: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, 11:25 of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,

lokele: limɔ BaIsalaele batotina beuwesomoko. Kwa loasɔnɔmɔkɔ nda Lokasa mbo— Boendoli ekuswaka nda okenge wa Siona, Atosokola litefoli lia Mungu ende bana ba Yakobo;
english: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

lokele: Elo loyalaka nde ngɛla yami end’iyo, Ani isosokoel’iyo batwanelo bau.
english: This is my covenant with them, when I will take away their sins.” Isaiah 59:20-21

lokele: Nda loasɔ loa Mboli Ilau bende biyani ko l’eoka yanu, nde loasɔ loa mbo basoaaomo, basosamomo ko l’eoka ya batata.
english: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.

lokele: Lifaefi la likomyi lia Mungu liotaka bato lioi, liao angokikolomo imɔ.
english: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

lokele: Kwa ino angɛnɛ watefokolaka Mungu oso, nde kwani osokelakomo booto ko l’eoka ya litefoli liau,
english: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,

lokele: ko ongoma iyo imɔ bende la litefoli mbo ko l’eoka ya booto ewakeelomoko ino, iyo imɔ kokeelomo kwani booto.
english: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.
