lokele: Mungu asokanjaka to batotina nda litefoli ko mbo awɛlɛkɛ iyo yaatotina booto wande.
english: For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.

lokele: Aina bolundu wa bondanda la wɛlï la liluwani lia Mungu! Eingo ko Boto angokɔkɔlɔ ndoosha litina lia bakomyi bande angoko bɛkɛndɛli yande.
english: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

lokele: ¿Ndai to aluwi baenyeli ba Ngɛnɛ Mungu? ¿Ndai asotwa lande ikumbɛ?
english: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?” Isaiah 40:13

lokele: ¿Ndai asotafaef’Inde bosömbo, mbo ainolomoko wao ko la Inde?
english: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?” Job 41:11

lokele: Eoka bitotina fɛɛ yasokwaka end’Inde, yakelomökö lande la bilainywaka ko end’Inde; tala biomaneke lande ko layalaya! Ongoma.
english: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

lokele: Bitungani yami, itolɔmbɔkɔl’ino ko l’eoka ya booto wa Mungu mbo ino bücheke bindo yanu nda etambelo ya lifaefi ende Mungu, lifaefi elile la liwawi la botanu ebotoomales’Inde, eoka mbo liyaleke lifaefi lia botema eliengani wewe.
english: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

lokele: Boyaeli wanu boyalëke kwa ewa bato ba e-mbile-ye, kangä boyaeli ebosokikolomo ko boyaeli boyai wa betema yanu mbo oluwakeke lisangi lia Mungu la njasɔ yande ebile bilau, eyakuliomoko lande, ebisoɔlɔlɔ hɔlɔhɔlɔ.
english: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

lokele: Isoonga to lanu batotina ebale eyanu, ko la isosha sha booto esifomu nde’mi, mbo oyalëke la bɔmɛtɔ la ifääla shoetela, kongo ko ndoenyakelaka liikami se kwa asokaela Mungu okaela oto la oto ikwelo sha lilendelu.
english: For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

lokele: Kwa iso tole la bilengo wike nda bindo ya oto la oto, la elengo la elengo eti la likuwa ko limwito;
english: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,

lokele: ko ongoma iso ebale wike, twende ko bindo ɛmwito ende Masiya la oto la oto ende ko elengo ende wina.
english: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,

lokele: Tosofomo to bafi bako ishosha sha likuwa lia bɔfɔɔnɔ la bɔfɔɔno kwa afomu nd’iso lifaefela; oyasofomo litɔndɔli, atɔndɔlɛkɛ ko la likaɔ elifomu end’inde,
english: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

lokele: ambo ende likuwa lia bosungi, asungeke to Etanda, oyasofomo boekesi, aekekeseke;
english: or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

lokele: oyasofomo lifumbesi, aongeleke bato la lifumbesi; bokusokoli wa lifaefi, ambo ko la bofäfä; oyasofomo botoli oso, ambo ko la itinjo; oyatɔkɛkɛ fɛtɛti ya booto, akɛkɛ la bɔfɔɔmu la limɛngɔ.
english: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

lokele: Losamɔ loanu lotayala la bolimbake,
english: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

lokele: siyamaka la bobe sia; wachanaka la bolau, ino beoto ya Etanda samanaka kwa bofindi ɔmɔi; wina atalieke wina lande tala.
english: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,

lokele: Yalaka l’itinjo, inga l’ilemolemo; yalakaka ko la Bolimo, kuwelaka Ngɛnɛ la bowangemu.
english: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,

lokele: Omalakaka la iyɛli, kɔkɔmɔkɔ nda bakongolomu; sombokolaka la boliliya.
english: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,

lokele: Kaelaka ebaEtanda yao ebile lau la boeno, sungak’iyo la bieka nda kɛndɔ yau.
english: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.

lokele: Samboelak’iyo ebatokongol’ino, sambolaka, osendëke bieo.
english: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.

lokele: Omalaka amamwito l’ebatoomala, lelaka l’ikɛnɛnɛ amamwito l’ebatolela.
english: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

lokele: Yalanaka la lisangi la botema ko ɔmɔi; oyalëke la bɔfɛnɔa, nde kɛsɛnɛkɛ l’eba touwe. Oyalëke l’ifääla shoenyela mbo wɛlï waɛ bosoetela.
english: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.

lokele: Okundanëke bobe ko la bosakane, enyaka ko ebiɛliami nda baiso ba bato batotina.
english: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

lokele: Bokɔkɔlɔ, ino koyalakanaka la batotina la lilatemi.
english: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

lokele: Ebasamomu lami, okundakanëke bakundo, nde faka efango ya Mungu fofe, eoka loasɔnɔmɔkɔ nda Lokasa loande mbo— Ngɛnɛ Mungu mbo— Likundeli lile ko loasɔ loami, Imi nd’atosakanesa njasɔ.
english: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.” Deuteronomy 32:35

lokele: Kongo ko wiyeli waɛ eokaka isiyɛ, fak’inde bieka; eokaka yɛmɛ ya balia, fak’inde amweke. Ongoma otowɛlɛ bösä wa sɔni nda botö wande. Okwesomöko liangɔ elitonana bobe, kongo ko kwesaka bobe ilangɔ ko la bowangɔ boko bolau.
english: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.” Proverbs 25:21-22

lokele: Batotina, boto la boto, baliteseke ebale l’isosha shokakalesa wenda, eoka angwɛnɛ isosha sakolo ngo ko esisofomo la Mungu, la ebale la shao basotomo ko la Mungu.
english: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

lokele: Eokao oyatotefola isosha, asotefola imɔ ko likomyi lia Mungu, la ebatotefola, iyo angɛnɛ batofomo se.
english: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.

lokele: Eoka bekomyi biti to ewaesa yowaesa ebakeli bolau, kangä ebakeli obe. ¿Otilɛmbɛ to owangaka ewa isosha? Kelaka to bolau, limɔ inde koomales’aɛ,
english: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,

lokele: eoka ale bokomyi wa Mungu ndoyales’aɛ la bolau. Bokela to obe, wangaka, eoka atifomo chaka ko wawa; ende to bonyafala wa Mungu wowɛlɛkɛ oyasokelaka obe ko efango ya Mungu.
english: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.

lokele: Eokao lole loasu ndolites’iyo, inga eoka yowanga efango ya Mungu kongo, kangä imɔ ko l’eoka ya eluwanelo yasu ya olau la obe.
english: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.

lokele: Ko l’eoka-ye otokambaka bɔsɔmbi, eoka bakomyi bende ebasofomo ko likuwa-li ko la Mungu.
english: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.

lokele: Faka to ende batotina yao eyengani, biko bɔsɔmbi ende ebengani ndosɔnja yao, bosömbo ende ebengani ndɔsɔ wao, wangaka oyengani ndowangomo, tɛmyaka oyengani ndotɛmyɔmɔ.
english: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

lokele: Oyalëke la bolima ende boto angɔmɔi, sakolo ngo ko bolima wosamaka bato basi; eoka oyatosamaka boyalani lande asokɔcha Bikela.
english: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

lokele: Eoka mbo baiti-ba bako-Otwëke nyongo, wolëke boto, wiyëke, ololëke yeka, ango liasi imɔ, batotina basosanoelomo ko la liölo-li limɔi liko mbo— Samaka boyalani laɛ kwa ani otosama aɛ angɛnɛ.
english: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” 13:9 “You shall not covet,” Exodus 20:13-15 and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.” Leviticus 19:18

lokele: Losamɔ loitokɔkɔlɔ ndokelela boyalani loasɔ ango lɔmɔi lobe, likɔchi lia Bikela liende ngo ko losamɔ.
english: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

lokele: Oisoluwa imɔ ngo ko mbo mbile-ye ende lisho lianu liosiswaka nda ilɔ esiingal’ino, eoka kwani liuwesi liasu lisosishana oko tina, ani liayalaka sumbu esika nda lise lina eliaimelak’iso osooso;
english: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

lokele: Bocho bosambosila, linyanya lisambosɔswa, eokao towatoleke to bekeeli ya lilima, biko eya sɔni, la towateke ko biɛla yonana nda löwa;
english: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.

lokele: tokɛndɛkɛndɛkɛ la löwa la boyaeli eboɛliami nda baiso ba bato, inga ndotinyaka tosumbe, la liwa lia bänä, inga la bolëfë la bolefela, inga la liwesani la liya;
english: Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.

lokele: kongo ko wataka boyaeli wa Ngɛnɛ Yesu Masiya la otakelëke bindo bolenda wa yɛmɛ ya yao.
english: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

lokele: Nyangelaka ewa lilendelu lilɛmbu nde inga to ko ndowesana lande eoka ya baenyeli bande.
english: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

lokele: Boto ɔmɔi asoimela mbo engani nde ndola bieka bitotina, kongo ko wasi wa bɔlɛmbu atolaka ko yeka ya elanga, angola nyama.
english: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

lokele: Oyatolaka asɛɔlɛ̈kɛ wasi oyatile, oyatokilaka yeka afëk’inde se oyatola yeka ena, ani Mungu asonyangela oto ona.
english: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

lokele: ¿Aɛ wende to ndai oyatofa bokuwi wa oto wasi se? Ko Ngɛnɛ ewande kongo nd’atof’inde kwa se, kwa likolo; atofomo nde likolo to, eoka Ngɛnɛ wasu atokɔkɔlɔ ndoemes’inde likolo.
english: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

lokele: Boto ɔmɔi atotanga nde lise limɔi lisolongela liasi, kongo wasi atangi nde bacho batotina batitwane; nde boto la boto akɔkɔmɛsɛkɛ lienyeli eliande angɛnɛ.
english: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

lokele: Oyatotanga lise limɔi mbo yenga, asoenyela ongoma ko loasɔ loa Ngɛnɛ; la oyatola yeka, atolaka ko l’eoka ya Ngɛnɛ eoka asofa Mungu kelekëlë, la oyatileke eoka ya Ngɛnɛ, asofa imɔ ko Mungu kelekëlë.
english: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

lokele: Eoka angwɛnɛ boto wasu oyatoyalaka eoka yande angɛnɛ, la angwɛnɛ boto kowa eoka yande angɛnɛ.
english: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

lokele: Eoka toyala to la liwawi, ango tosoyala eba Ngɛnɛ; la eya mbo towa, tosowa ko eba Ngɛnɛ; eokao to toyala la liwawi, la towa, twende ango koa eba Ngɛnɛ.
english: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

lokele: Liende ngo ko la litina-li mbo Masiya awaka la auwaka liasi, mbo ayaleke ko Ngɛnɛ wa eba liwa l’eba liwawi lisanga.
english: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

lokele: ¿Aɛ nd’atofa etungani yaɛ se eoka iye? ¿Aɛ nd’atosɛɔlɔ imɔ etungani yaɛ eoka iye? Eoka iso yaatotina totoemakala oso wa kɛka ya likomanyi lia Mungu;
english: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

lokele: kwa asɔnɔmɔkɔ loao nda Lokasa mbo— Mungu mbo— Kwa ayali Imi, batotina batoswakela’mi balui se, La bɛnɔkɔ bitotina bitoaolela Mungu mbo Ngɛnɛ.
english: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’” Isaiah 45:23

lokele: Ongoma to ɔmɔi la ɔmɔi wasu atokasanoela Ngɛnɛ Mungu loasɔ loande angɛnɛ.
english: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

lokele: Eokao totakomyianëk’imɔ boto la boto wina lande, nde komyiaka baenyeli banu mbo angotak’imɔ loasɔ nda mboka ya etungani lokwes’inde ango ilango, ango likulya.
english: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

lokele: Isoenyela la isoluwa imɔ ko l’isosha sha Ngɛnɛ Yesu mbo angwɛnɛ yeka eyele bokili ko yao angɛnɛ, sakolo ngo ko end’inde oyatangi nde mbo ende bokili, ambo ende bokili end’inde.
english: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

lokele: Nde eya mbo etungani yaɛ eokesomoko botema wale eoka ya bieka ebitol’aɛ, ani otikɛsɛnɛ lande la losamɔ imɔ; osɛɛsɛlɛsɛ̈kɛ inde ona oyawelomoko la Masiya, ko l’eoka ya bieka eyaɛ.
english: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

lokele: Omachëke mbo eyaɛ bilau bisendakomoko bieo,
english: Then don’t let your good be slandered,

lokele: eoka Bɔkɔta wa Mungu boti loasɔ loa yeka yola kwa yomwa, kangä eloa liengani la lilatemi la bootaota wa Bolimo Botanu;
english: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

lokele: eoka oyatokuwela Masiya la boyaeli-bo inde nd’atoomalesa Mungu, la atokuliomo lokuku lolau ende bato.
english: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

lokele: Eokao to, totutakeke ko njasɔ ya lilatemi la ebitokɔkɔmɛsɛ baina lasu.
english: So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

lokele: Owɛlɛ̈kɛ likuwa lia Mungu se ko loasɔ loa bieka. Bitotina bisosäsa, angwɛnɛ bokili, kongo ko bobe finɛ ende boto ona oyatokwesa boto se ko l’eoka ya bieka yola.
english: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

lokele: Bolau ko ndokila nyama ya kanda bitoti la bänä ango yeka yasi imɔ ebitokwesa etungani yaɛ.
english: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

lokele: Lilendelu liaɛ liyaleke nda botema waɛ olo Mungu kongo nd’atɔɛnɛ liao; lɔkɛmɔ lole ende inde oyatikɔkɔlɛ ndofa botema Wande se eoka ya yeka ena eyetangi inde mbo elau.
english: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

lokele: Nde oyatotaka fee, limɔ elaka yeka ena, asofomo se eoka atileke la lilendelu; bitotina to ebiti la liimeli bile ko batwanelo.
english: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

lokele: Iso to ebale la bosangwu nda lilendelu tosungeke eba bɔlɛmbu ndotolaka belito ya fee ebile lau angoluka fofe yoomala ko iso angɛnɛ;
english: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

lokele: nde oto la oto wasu aomaleseke boyalani nda njasɔ bilau ndokɔkɔmɛsɛ Etanda.
english: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

lokele: Eoka Masiya atiaomalesaka Inde angɛnɛ, nde lole kwa asɔnɔmɔkɔ nda Lokasa, mbo— Baɛngɔ ebafomoko end’aɛ, basokwa ko ende Imi.
english: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.” Psalms 69:9

lokele: Eoka eyasɔnɔmɔkɔ kwala, losɔnɔmɔ eoka ndoekes’iso mbo ende ko la likɔkɔmɛlɛ la lisungi lia Kasa ya Mungu mbo toyaleke la iyɛli angɛnɛ.
english: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

lokele: Mungu to oyale Ngɛnɛ wa bɔkɔkɔmu la lisungi lia otema afek’ino fofe yoyalaka la botema ɔmwito kwa alɛmbi ko Masiya Yesu,
english: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,

lokele: mbo ko la botema ɔmwito la limiki limwito ino kotaliaka Mungu tala, ako Sango wa Ngɛnɛ wasu Yesu Masiya. Bato ba tukela bitoti bawatianeke mbate eoka ya Masiya
english: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

lokele: Eokao nyangelanaka kwa asokela imɔ ko Masiya ndonyangel’ino mbo Mungu ataliomoko tala.
english: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, 15:7 to the glory of God.

lokele: Imi mbo Masiya ayaka to ende BaYuda eba iongo sha itombe nda boyaeli wa bosungi ndokɔkɔmɛsɛ wewe wa Mungu la ndokɔkɔmɛsɛ imɔ basakä ebafomoko batata,
english: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,

lokele: la mbo eba tukela yasi baineleke Mungu eoka ya booto wande end’iyo, kwa asɔnɔmɔkɔ nda Lokasa mbo— Eokao, itoaolaka lina liaɛ la liineli ende eba wenda bototi, La itotwa bɔɛlɛ woinela lina liaɛ.
english: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore I will give praise to you among the Gentiles and sing to your name.” 2 Samuel 22:50

lokele: Liasi imɔ mbo— Omalaka la limɛngɔ, ino ba wenda bototi, Amamwito l’eba tukela ya Mungu.
english: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.” Deuteronomy 32:43

lokele: Liasi imɔ mbo— Inelaka Yawe, ino ba wenda, Ino bato batotina yaimweselak’Inde.
english: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.” Psalms 117:1

lokele: La Yesaya imɔ mbo— Oyaotomökö nda bofindi wa Yese eyaka nde, La oyatotaliomo atokakalesa eba wenda; Iyɛli sha tukela bitotina sile ko end’Inde.
english: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.” Isaiah 11:10

lokele: Mungu to Ngɛnɛ wa iyɛli shasu, atumesek’ino la bootaota la lilatemi ko la lilendelu mbo ofoteke la iyɛli shanu ko la bofoka wa Bolimo Botanu.
english: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.

lokele: Bitungani yami, iluwi to ndoluwa imi angɛnɛ loasɔ loanu mbo ino angɛnɛ osotuma fuu la bolau, la liluwani la wɛli la mbo otokɔkɔlɔ imɔ ndoekesa basi.
english: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, 15:14 that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.

lokele: Isosɔnɛl’ino la lotendela nda botüku ɔmɔi ko ndoenyakeles’ino njasɔ bimɔi ko la booto ebosofomo’mi ko la Mungu,
english: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

lokele: oyasota’mi lioi ndoyala wɛndi wa Masiya Yesu ende tukela ya wenda; yende sumbu kwa kanga wa Mboli Ilau ya Mungu oyatotambela Inde eba wenda kwa lifaefi elitokuliomo olau la elitoüchomo ko la Bolimo Botanu.
english: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

lokele: Yende to la litina liomala la bɔmɛtɔ sumbu loasɔ loa likuwa liami lia Mungu ko l’eoka ya Masiya Yesu.
english: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

lokele: Iitotendela ndoonga loasɔ loasi, sakolo ngo ko nda yao ebisokela Masiya angɛnɛ ko lami ndokesa eba tukela ya wenda, ko la lioi la bekeeli imɔ
english: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

lokele: ko la ndembe ya tokesa twa bofoka wa Bolimo Botanu; ongoma nda Yelusaleme la nda yese bitimbi konda yese olo ayali Makedonia, isɔɔlɔlɔ ndonangokola Mboli Ilau ya Masiya;
english: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;

lokele: ongoma to yasamaka sumbu finɛ fofe yonangola Mboli Ilau olo atianangoelomoko lina lia Masiya oso, mbo itaswa likolo lia lionda lia oto wasi,
english: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.

lokele: kangä kwa asɔnɔmɔkɔ nda Lokasa mbo— Ebatianangoelomoko mboli yande, belɛnɛkɛ to Inde, La ebatiokaka, belaluwesomoko litina. Mboti ya kɛndɔ ebisosanga Paulo ko mbisa
english: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.” Isaiah 52:15

lokele: Ko la litina-li isotakufesomo bäkufa wike mbo itaya end’ino
english: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,

lokele: nde kwanikwani itiɛnɛ imɔ fofe ya likuwa nda yese-ye, isoyala la yɛmɛ finɛ yɔɛn’ino ko la miaka wike;
english: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

lokele: ongoma to akakɛkɛ’mi nda yese ya Isipanya, iyɛli shami sile mbo yɛnɛk’ino ani atoeta’mi la mbo ino okatikɛkɛ’mi nda mboka mbisa ani isookana lanu limɛngɔ sumbu.
english: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.

lokele: Kongo ko isotakɛ nda Yelusaleme okatika lisungi liko lifaefi ende ebaEtanda,
english: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

lokele: Eoka eba tukela ya Makedonia la Akaiya basosanga osɔnjaka lifaefi la limɛngɔ ndokaela liao ende eba touwe ba Etanda nda Yelusaleme;
english: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.

lokele: basokela to ongoma la limɛngɔ la bende lau la bolima eoka ango eba tukela yasi bɛɔlɔ likaɔ lia lifaefi lia bolimo elisoesha BaYuda, ongoma lole loau ndosunga imɔ ko BaYuda la yeka eyele la bindo yau la boeno.
english: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.

lokele: Akasileke’mi lotomo-lo, la akaɔlek’iyo lifaefi-li elisomonya’mi, limɔ itoketa eyanu okakɛ nda Isipanya.
english: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.

lokele: Iluwi nde mbo akayeke’mi end’ino, itoeshel’ino ambole ya lifotesi lia Masiya.
english: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.

lokele: Bitungani yami, isolɔmbɔkɔl’ino ko la Ngɛnɛ wasu Yesu Masiya la ko la losamɔ loa Bolimo mbo iso lanu lami tofumbakaneke nda lisomboli ende Mungu loasɔ loami,
english: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

lokele: mbo yɔnɔkɔlɔmɔkɔ nda besamba ya ba Yudea ebatiimele, la mbo lotomo loami losung’iyo loomaleseke eba Etanda nda Yelusaleme,
english: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,

lokele: la mbo iyek’end’ino la bootaota, la Mungu ɛlɛmbɛ ongoma, imi koɛumaka sumbu amamwito lanu.
english: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

lokele: Mungu Ngɛnɛ wa lilatemi ayaleke to lanu yaatotina. Ongoma.
english: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

lokele: Itoomb’ino ndonyangela welo wasu, bosungi otomali wa Etanda, ako Foibe wa Kenekelea oyasoya end’ino la lokasa-lo.
english: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant 16:1 of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

lokele: Nyangelak’inde ko eoka ya Ngɛnɛ la bonyangeli woengana eba Etanda, la sungak’inde la bitotina ebikayaleke’inde la boeno eoka inde angɛnɛ ayali nde bosungi bolau wa bato wike lami imɔ lisanga.
english: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

lokele: Seelaka Pulisika la Akwila, bakuwakani lami nda tomo ya Masiya Yesu,
english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

lokele: ebasikiotenomo kingo loasɔ loami, eokao lami la eba Etanda nda tukela yasi bitotina, tosofaef’iyo kelekëlë finɛ;
english: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

lokele: seelak’imɔ ko eba Etanda omolo nda ndakɔ yau. Seelaka imɔ Epeneto oyasamomu lami la oyayalaka ewa oso wokalangana nda yese ya Asia nda njasɔ ya Masiya.
english: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

lokele: Seelaka Malia oyasokuwel’ino la likuwa lifi.
english: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

lokele: Seelaka Andeloniko la Yunia eba bofindi wasu l’ebakandomoko amamwito lami nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ ebale la lokuku sisi ya Batomomu la ebaaka eba Masiya oso wami.
english: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.

lokele: Seelaka Ampuliato oyasamomu lami la losamɔ loa Ngɛnɛ wasu.
english: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

lokele: Seelaka Ulabano bokuwani lami nda tomo ya Masiya, la Sitaku oyasamomu lami.
english: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

lokele: Seelaka Apele oyakuliomu nda likuwa lia Masiya, la seelaka eba bofindi wa Alistobulo.
english: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

lokele: Seelaka Helodione wa bofindi wami. Seelaka eba Ngɛnɛ Yesu ba bofindi wa Nalekiso.
english: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

lokele: Seelaka Tulufina la Tulufosa ebatokuwekela Ngɛnɛ. Seelaka Pelusi botomali bosamomu oyatokuwela Ngɛnɛ la bofiili.
english: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

lokele: Seelaka Lufo boto olau wa Ngɛnɛ la nyango wande oyale imɔ kwa nyango ende’mi.
english: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

lokele: Seelaka Asunkilito la Felengona la Helemese la Pateloba la Helema la bitungani yau ebile omao.
english: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers 16:14 who are with them.

lokele: Seelaka Filolongo la Yulia Neleo la welo wande, la Olumpa la batotina ebüchomu ebale amamwito lau.
english: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

lokele: Lamolanaka la tɔchɔu etüchomu ende eba Etanda kongo; bitanda bitoti ya Masiya bitoseela ino. Boimo wa Paulo eoka ya eba bolimbakeli
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

lokele: Bitungani yami, isolɔmbɔkɔl’ino ndwɛnɛkɛ sumbu ebatofɔɔkɔlɔ liwesani l’ebatokufesa lɔkɛndɔ loa eba Etanda mbo batakɛkɛ fii nda yao ebiaekesomökö ino; engwaki bato ana.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.

lokele: Bato ba bɔfɔɔnɔ-bo baitolitesa Masiya Ngɛnɛ wasu nda likuwa liande, kangä ko sɔlɔ yau angɛnɛ; baoi bau ba ngwasu la bɔlɛtɛlɛtɛ batolimbaka betema ya eba ndundu.
english: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

lokele: Lokuku loa lilitesi lianu losofafana ende batotina, eokao isoomala to loasɔ loanu, kongo ko ilɛmbi ino ndoyala la wɛlï finɛ nda njasɔ bilau la esaela nda njasɔ bibe.
english: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

lokele: Limɔ Mungu Ngɛnɛ wa lilatemi atomatekela Satana mate lisasaya ose ya batindi banu. Booto wa Yesu Masiya, Ngɛnɛ wasu, boyalakeke lanu! Baseeli basi ba Paulo
english: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

lokele: Timoteo bokuwani lami, asoseel’ino imɔ ko Lukia la Yasona la Sɔpatulo ba bofindi wami basoseel’ino.
english: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

lokele: Imi Teleteo oyasɔni lokasa-lo itoseel’ino la losamɔ loa Ngɛnɛ wasu.
english: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

lokele: Gaiyo oyasofa’mi ndakɔ la eba Etanda batotina, basoseel’ino. Elaseto botingani wa bieto ya bokenge-bo la Kulato etungani yasu basoseel’ino. Lisomboli lia tuu ya lokasa
english: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

lokele: Tala end’Inde to oyasokɔkɔlɔ ndokɔkɔmɛsɛ ino kɔkɛ ko la lilendelu lia Mboli Ilau ebisonangola’mi, biko wɛndi wa Yesu Masiya, wao bole lɔɛnɛsɔ loa njasɔ eyaisamaka la ebitiaongomökö kwalakwala,
